"wangdi <ddiwang@google.com>" uploaded a new patch: https://review.whamcloud.com/c/fs/lustre-release/+/67460
Subject: LU-20512 quota: check for NULL qsd_dev in qsd functions
Project: fs/lustre-release
Branch: master
Current Patch Set: 1
Commit: 0d813af9f6b8a2861ace63ac8fb19b602e93deac
duplicate with LU-20080
LU-20080

I'm a bit suspicious of this, because patch https://review.whamcloud.com/65414 ("LU-19921 ptlrpc: update nodemap for gssiam") is the only patch that has triggered this crash in the past 4 weeks, and it did so on the last two updates...

>I'm a bit suspicious of this, because patch https://review.whamcloud.com/65414 ("LU-19921 ptlrpc: update nodemap for gssiam") is the only patch that has triggered this crash in the past 4 weeks, and it did so on the last two updates...

Yeah, I do not understand this. The only thing I can think of is that this patch will migrate dynamic nodemap during umount/remount process, which may increase the chance of exposing this race.
